programme.title: Tiny Desk Concerts Japan
programme.desc: yano et agatsuma present new traditional Japanese music with piano, shamisen and electronic sounds.

programme.title: Bosai: Science That Can Save Your Life
programme.desc: We look at Japan's efforts to improve tsunami evacuation, from overcoming 'normalcy bias' that causes people to underestimate risk to the installation of coastal evacuation towers.

programme.title: Hand-Making The Scenery Of Life
programme.desc: Yamagata / Minagawa Akira (Designer): To make a 'dantsu' carpet, everything from yarn-making to weaving is done by hand - Minagawa experiences the deep allure of handmade goods.

programme.title: NHK Newsline

programme.title: Samurai Castles
programme.desc: Wakayama Castle was a crucial castle for Toyotomi Hideyoshi and Tokugawa Ieyasu who both guided Japan to peace, its location south of the economic centre of Osaka near the Pacific Ocean was strategic.

programme.title: Magical Japanese
programme.desc: Water: The Japanese language is rich in words and expressions influenced by nature, history and culture. This episode looks at words related to water. Explore the unique culture behind them.

programme.title: Matsuri: The Heartbeat Of Japan
programme.desc: The highlight of Onabare is nerikomi, which involves the careful wielding of a long and heavy pole - follow the parade of a portable shrine through the streets with performances along the way.

programme.title: NHK Newsline
programme.desc: NHK World-Japan's flagship news programme delivers the latest world news, business and weather with a focus on Japan and the rest of Asia.

programme.title: Documentary 360
programme.desc: On a hill near the ocean is a telephone booth known as the 'Telephone of the Wind' - it is connected to nowhere, but people come to whisper messages to family members lost in the 2011 tsunami.

programme.title: NHK Newsline

programme.title: J-Melo

programme.title: Little Charo
programme.desc: Animation series about a Japanese dog who meets and is helped by many mythical creatures of northern Japan as he searches for eight star talismans.

programme.title: Japanology Plus Mini
programme.desc: Onigiri is Japan's comfort food - we explore new types trending on social media, the latest convenience store offerings, and an emergency version that can be stored at room temperature for five years.

programme.title: A Cat's-Eye View Of Japan
programme.desc: Ricky was born in an apple orchard in a perfect playground for mischievous kittens while Peh spends the autumn in golden rice fields hiding and hunting grasshoppers - watch out for his pounce!

programme.title: Cycle Around Japan Highlights

programme.title: Rockie And Her Friends

programme.title: I Love 'Mee'

programme.title: Somewhere Street

programme.title: Easy Japanese For Work
